name: Mr Happy
noteEs: Mr Happy es el creator de FFXIV más longevo en YouTube, cubriendo el juego desde A Realm Reborn en 2013 sin pausa. Sus videos cubren todo el espectro: job guides para principiantes, raid walkthroughs detallados de Savage y Ultimate, recaps de Live Letters y análisis de patch notes. Su tono es calmado y didáctico, lejos del hype-bait. Para muchos jugadores fue el primer creator que vieron al unlockear Free Trial — y siguen volviendo cada patch.
noteEn: Mr Happy is the longest-running FFXIV YouTube creator, covering the game since A Realm Reborn in 2013 without pause. His videos cover the full spectrum: job guides for beginners, detailed Savage and Ultimate raid walkthroughs, Live Letter recaps, and patch notes analysis. His tone is calm and educational, far from hype-bait. For many players he was the first creator they watched after unlocking the Free Trial — and they keep coming back each patch.
highlightsEs: Cubriendo FFXIV continuamente desde A Realm Reborn (2013)
Job guides comprehensivas para los 21+ jobs del juego
Walkthroughs de cada Savage tier y Ultimate fight
Recaps editoriales de Live Letters y análisis de patch notes
Tono didáctico sin hype: referencia confiable para nuevos jugadores
highlightsEn: Continuously covering FFXIV since A Realm Reborn (2013)
Comprehensive job guides for all 21+ jobs in the game
Walkthroughs for every Savage tier and Ultimate fight
Editorial recaps of Live Letters and patch notes analysis
Educational tone without hype: a reliable reference for new players
